config.torchplanner.title: Torch Planner
config.torchplanner.show_dark_spots.tool: Red squares on every block a monster can spawn on right now. Purple squares (always shown) are dark spots no floor torch in range can light.
config.torchplanner.through_walls.toolti: Draw markers on top of terrain so you can plan caves from outside them.
config.torchplanner.horizontal_radius.to: How far around you to plan. Large radii take a few seconds and need a render distance that covers them (256 blocks = 17 chunks). Gold markers show up to 256 blocks away; red squares only near you. Applies on the next rescan.
message.torchplanner.done: Torch Planner: all torches placed, scanning again
config.torchplanner.vertical_radius.tool: How far up and down to plan. Applies on the next rescan.
config.torchplanner.rescan.tooltip: Throw away the current plan and plan again around where you're standing. The plan otherwise stays fixed until every suggested torch is placed.
message.torchplanner.planned_partial: Torch Planner: %s torches to place (part of the area wasn't loaded; raise render distance to cover it)
